sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Drip-Out - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Believe it or not, my business has taken off, and it's going strong! I'm thinking of expanding again. Help me out again, yes-yes?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 100 Rogues
- Hand over 50 found in raid LBT brand equipment

sections.heading: BEAR Exclusive
sections.text:
- Unlocks purchase of BEAR OPS MGS Black clothing at Ragman LL3
- Unlocks purchase of BEAR URON Coyote clothing at Ragman LL3

sections.heading: USEC Exclusive
sections.text:
- Unlocks purchase of USEC BOSS Delta MC clothing at Ragman LL3
- Unlocks purchase of USEC Defender WG clothing at Ragman LL3

"Uhh, you want your cut? Here's the thing, brother, it's kinda not an option, you know? Better yet, look at this new drip I'm offering now!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you need to kill 100 Rogues and hand over 50 pieces of LBT brand equipment with found in raid status.
